about: Dotted rank and office titles before a capitalised name (loop B140, CROSS X-052): Capt./Lt./Col./Sgt./Gen./Maj./Cpl./Adm./Cmdr./Prof./Rev./Insp./Supt./Gov./Sen./Pres./Msgr./Fr. -> Captain, Lieutenant ... Ported from EpubToM4B tests/fixtures/spoken_dotted_titles.json (auto/loop) plus GPS street cases. Left out on purpose: 'I live on Water St.' and 'She lives on Elm St now.' (Backseat respells the heteronyms live/lives), and 'Café St. Germain' / 'Ève St. Clair' (BookLyre reads 'Street.' there; Backseat reads Saint, which is right). Backseat also drops the period in 'Ken Griffey, Sr., played' the way BookLyre does. Loop B142 (CROSS X-053) adds BookLyre's 16 cases from EpubToM4B 92d38349 tests/fixtures/spoken_titles.json (Pvt./Pfc./Spc./Brig./Det./Amb./Atty./Bro., 3rd Div./Regt./Bn., ext. 42) plus 4 GPS cases; Backseat says the ordinals and numbers as words ('the third Division', 'extension forty two'). Backseat Driver: backseat::pronunciation::ForSpeech / DottedTitles, Titles (libs/backseat/pronunciation_streets.hpp).
